purpose: Phase 1 of #5111: establish one canonical public header authority and remove the proven mobile header/readability regressions without changing registration, authentication, protected cabinets or production authority.
effectiveAfter: This governance manifest is independently reviewed and merged to main. The implementation branch must then be rematerialized on that accepted main and may change only the paths below.
requiredInvariants: PublicSiteHeader is the single geometry authority for homepage and linked public surfaces; personal/protected cabinet chrome is unchanged.

At 320, 375, 390 and 430 CSS px the public header remains one row, does not exceed the canonical compact-height contract, keeps the full canonical brand name visible, keeps menu/language/login/registration reachable, and creates no horizontal overflow.
No route-local 96-100px wrapped homepage header authority may remain active after this phase.
Visible interactive targets required by existing acceptance remain at least 44x44 CSS px; no accessibility or responsive gate is weakened to obtain PASS.

The homepage primary registration CTA and header registration action continue to point to the existing /platform-v7/register route; registration/authentication semantics and role assignment are unchanged.
The existing 320px Hero H1 line-count, first-viewport CTA, 14px minimum explanatory text, anchor-not-obscured, RU/EN/ZH and zero-overflow contracts remain authoritative.
Contact accessible brand-home labels remain locale-native in RU/EN/ZH while the visible canonical product brand remains coherent.
No API, database, RBAC, tenant, registration business logic, personal cabinet, release workflow, production host or REG.RU action is changed in this scope.
No paid dependency, external SaaS or recurring cost is introduced.
requiredChecks: Platform V7 Design System v8 Acceptance
Canonical SBOM Generation & IP Clean Room
independent exact-head review under the repository review gate
forbiddenChanges: RBAC, tenant, API or database semantics
release workflows or production deployment authority
acceptance weakening, skipped responsive assertions or reduced touch targets
maturityBoundary: Pre-merge browser/CI evidence is not production acceptance. Final 100/100 still requires exact merged SHA publication, REG.RU exact-SHA deployment, fresh production browser gates and human visual inspection on required mobile/desktop viewports.
